messages:
Anna (CS): FYI — Acme Health replied to the vendor risk form. They want a dataflow diagram + SOC2 scope confirmation ahead of next week's renewal call. Sounds time-sensitive.
Mike (Onboarding): Got it. Do they want full env-level flow or just customer-data paths?
Anna (CS): They asked for 'how customer data enters, where it's stored, and who can access it' — so customer-data paths + storage retention.
Sam (Infra): I can sketch the infra flow. Quick Q: are we showing Dedicated vs Hosted paths? They use Redwood Hosted today.
Anna (CS): Hosted only for them. But they asked whether Dedicated is an option for future — just a one-liner is fine.
Lina (Legal): I'll review the DPA clauses after we produce the flow. Also confirm: they specifically called out KMS & region residency.
Mike (Onboarding): I'll pull the latest dataflow we used for Velveta last quarter and update retention fields.
Sam (Infra): Pasting a minimal diagram snippet here for review:```
source: customer-app
ingest: api.redwood.com (SSL)
store: s3-us-east-1 (encrypted, KMS=aws-kms-key-abc)
processing: redwood-hosted-gpu-pool (ephemeral KV cache)
access: role-based, tokenized, audit-logs -> cloudwatch
retention: embeddings=180d, logs=30d
```
Lina (Legal): Looks fine. Two notes: 1) we should call out that embeddings can be purged on request (data deletion clause). 2) For SOC2 scope, confirm that logging and incident response are in-scope.
Anna (CS): I'll add the purge option and the SOC2 bullets. Mike — can you add a short note about timelines for deletion?
Mike (Onboarding): Yes — we do scheduled purge job: `cron: purge_embeddings --age 180d` and manual deletion via support within 48 hours. Adding that.
OpsBot: Automated check: DPA template has KMS field present = true, region specified = us-east-1. 
Sam (Infra): One more small ask — they want an exported diagram (png) and a simple CSV mapping of subprocessors. I'll export both and drop into the customer folder.
Anna (CS): Great. Lina, can you sign off once I update the doc? If we can get this by EOD tomorrow, we should be safe for the renewal call. :hourglass_flowing_sand:
Lina (Legal): I can review tomorrow morning. If anything sensitive appears, I'll flag it. :thumbsup:
Mike (Onboarding): I'll attach the diagram + CSV here when ready.
Anna (CS): Thanks team — keeping this thread as the source of truth. Will ping Acme after legal sign-off.
Mike (Onboarding): Attached: `acme-dataflow-1700.png`, `acme-subprocessor-list-1700.csv` (upload to drive).
Anna (CS): Sent to customer with a short cover note and proposed 15-min sync before renewal.
Sam (Infra): Marking as done on infra deliverables.
Anna (CS): Closing loop — Lina approved, customer acknowledged receipt, renewal call scheduled. Closing thread. :white_check_mark:
